featured_reviews.review_text: I got to know about Cinnamon Tree after tasting a delicious chocolate cake at a friends place. Then I ordered a whipping cream vanilla cake for my daughters birthday. featured_reviews.review_text: We had awesome experience of ordering jungle theme birthday cake from cinnamon tree, look of the cake was really great also it tasted beyond our expectations, all of us were licking our fingers. featured_reviews.name: Poonam Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am new in Bangalore and don't have much idea about good bakeries. I was searching for good cake stores for my daughter's 10th birthday and while googling found THE CINNAMON TREE. I read so many positive reviews about this store and decided to call and check about their rates and services. Ranjeeta the store owner is a very nice lady and she is ready to customize the cake according to your requirement. After talking to her I decided to give my cake order to her only. And I also asked her to make return gift hampers with THANK YOU note for all the guests. The hamper had very yummy CHOCOLATE CUPCAKE, CHOCOLATE POP and COOKIES.
On party day when everybody had cake they were so happy... the cake was so yummy and fresh with perfect sweetness and my daughter's friends were so happy with their yummy return gift hampers.

Once again thanks a lot to Ranjeeta for baking such a yummy cake for my daughter.

It’s light n has a very different taste other than what u get anywhere else. It’s been 24 yrs n 1000’s of cake trials all over the world but this recipe gives Sukoon. Btw, i happen to come across karan johar's interview, where he mentioned how he could eat this whole cake all by himself. NO one believed me, when i said that am not sharing. you can just keep eating...

featured_reviews.name: Anushree Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text: It has been a tradition in my house to buy our birthday cakes from Goriawalla's. My mum got all her birthday cakes from here, and now we do (more than 30 years) !  I can vouch for the fact that Goriawalla's cakes are simply put, the BEST I've ever had. No other fancy bakery can ever compete with the taste of the cakes baked here. This bakery is a perfect example of how consumers ultimately give precedence to taste over fancy-looking, average cakes, and the fact that it has stood the test of time, is a testimony to it.

featured_reviews.name: Poushalee Dey
featured_reviews.review_text:
CRÈME Cookies – A Warm, Gooey Delight in Tardeo

CRÈME Cookies, a recent addition to Mumbai’s dessert scene, specializes in thick, chunky, New York-style cookies that promise a perfect balance of crisp edges and gooey centers. Tucked away in Tardeo, this spot has already built a reputation for serving some of the most indulgent cookies in the city.

From the moment we walked in, the aroma of freshly baked cookies filled the air, setting the perfect mood for a sugar rush. We ordered a mix of their bestsellers, including classic chocolate, Nutella-filled creations, and a couple of their signature cake cups. Each bite was rich, buttery, and decadent without being overly sweet. The cookies were served warm and fresh, with a satisfyingly soft, melt-in-the-mouth texture. The cake cups, too, were indulgent, though some flavors stood out more than others.

While the flavors were spot on, we felt that some cookies could have used a bit more contrast in texture, perhaps a slightly crispier exterior to balance out the gooey center. The cake cups, while tasty, could have packed a little more depth in certain flavors. That said, CRÈME definitely knows how to make a seriously good cookie.

With a premium price tag, it’s not an everyday indulgence, but for anyone who loves big, bold, and gooey cookies, CRÈME is absolutely worth a visit. A strong 4/5 from us—nearly perfect, and dangerously addictive.

Would we return? Without a doubt.

Brownie Point

A very famous sweet made in Goa for Christmas and getting to try these in Bombay is really heart warming.
They are made with sweet dough also having various names.
They are crunchy to have and sweet and a perfect snack to have on Christmas with your friends and family.

Another sweet Goa is known for😍
Milk cream is basically cashew nut and milk fudge made by Goans to get the Christmas feel started 🤩

•Marzi paan
So this one is very famous among East Indians made with paste of almonds or cashews and given cute shapes.
They are definitely sweet and come in various colour, shapes and sizes and definitely a must try.

•Fruit mince pie
So the pie takes a little longer to make but is an absolute delight to the heart😍
It consists of dried mixed fruits stuffed in a pie giving us the Christmas feels.
Also there are various ways to decorate it but the star shape really looks cute and gives the traditional feels.

Without plum cakes Christmas is incomplete ❤️
Plum cakes are made with fruits and have a very rich feel to it.
This one was extremely beautifully made and is a must try.
Was soft and flavorful and would highly recommend it to all

There were exactly 3 ingredients in the cake - Cookie, layers of fresh cream and strawberry pieces. If I go to think about it any1 can make this at home if I purchase these ingredients from the store, and im sure that will be more edible. None of us liked the cake, its spoilt the occasion and on the top of all when I messaged ul expressing my disappointment, ul choose to ignore. So honestly I think this place is not professional at all and people shud think twice before placing their orders.
